title: The Fourth Floor
summary: On Day seven, Sam and Mrs. Okafor decide how to reach the roof key.

beats.text: Day seven. Biscuit growled at the door all night, so I opened it.
Empty hallway. Wet footprints ended at the stairwell door.
"Two days to the last boat," said Mrs. Okafor. "We need Hale's key."
Leo raised his bat. "I volunteer Biscuit." Nobody laughed.
The walkie crackled. Hale said: back stairs, noon, quiet.
Noon meant daylight, when they are slow. Still, I heard them shuffle.
We packed light. Mrs. Okafor stayed to guard the door.
Leo and I started down. Biscuit stopped on the sixth step.
Every shape at the bottom turned toward us.
Hale whispered, "Whatever you do, do not let the dog bark."
beats.speaker: hale

beats.text: Biscuit opened his mouth. I did not breathe.
